email: I was charged twice for my monthly subscription.
expected_summary: Customer reports being charged twice for their subscription.

email: I cannot log into my account even after resetting my password.
expected_summary: Customer cannot access their account after resetting their password.

email: The app freezes whenever I upload a large document.
expected_summary: Customer reports the application freezing while uploading a large document.

email: How do I change my subscription from monthly to yearly?
expected_summary: Customer wants to change their subscription from monthly to yearly billing.
notes: Subscription plan change related to billing.

notes: Contains both billing and account issues; billing is primary.

email: I forgot my password and the reset email never arrived.
expected_summary: Customer cannot reset their password because the reset email did not arrive.
notes: Password recovery and account access issue.

email: I uploaded a PDF but the page just keeps loading and nothing happens.
expected_summary: Customer reports a PDF upload that remains stuck loading.

email: Why did my subscription price increase this month?
expected_summary: Customer is asking why their subscription price increased.

email: My account says it is locked and I have no idea why.
expected_summary: Customer reports that their account is locked.

email: Everything was working yesterday but today the dashboard won't load.
expected_summary: Customer reports that the dashboard is no longer loading.

email: I cancelled last week but money was still taken from my card.
expected_summary: Customer reports being charged after cancelling their subscription.
notes: Cancellation followed by an unexpected charge.

email: cant get in. changed password twice. still says invalid credentials.
expected_summary: Customer cannot log in despite changing their password twice.
notes: Informal wording and repeated password reset attempts.

email: Every time I click export the application crashes.
expected_summary: Customer reports the application crashing when attempting to export.

email: I can't log in and I need to update the card used for my subscription.
expected_summary: Customer cannot log in and needs to update their subscription payment card.
notes: Contains account and billing issues; account access is the immediate blocker.

email: paid already!!! why does it keep saying payment failed???
expected_summary: Customer reports that a completed payment is still being shown as failed.
notes: Informal wording with conflicting payment status.
